author: adramelekh.
content:
## 🧪 AI Lab
  • **Hugging Face** — Explore open models and datasets, build demos, and share AI experiments with the
  community.

  • **Gradio** — Fast way to turn a Python AI project into a simple interactive web demo.

  • **Cloudflare Workers AI** — Add hosted open-model AI features to an app without operating GPUs.

  • **Cloudflare Workers** — Serverless platform for lightweight APIs, bots, automations, and edge
  applications.
  • **Docker** — Package your app and its dependencies into a reproducible container, so “works on my
  machine” becomes “works anywhere.”

  • **Docker Sandboxes** — Isolated environments for letting coding agents experiment, install packages, and
  run commands without touching your main computer or project setup.

  • **Environment variables** — Keep API keys, database URLs, and secrets out of code and out of GitHub.

  • **Supabase RLS** — Database access rules that prevent users from reading or editing each other’s private
  data.

  • **Testnet first** — Test wallet and smart-contract flows on testnet before any mainnet launch.

  • **Transaction simulation** — Preview what a wallet transaction will do before asking a user to sign it.

author: adramelekh.
content:
## 🧱 App Stack
  • **GitHub** — Your project’s source of truth: saves code, tracks changes, and enables collaboration.

  • **v0** — Prompt-to-UI builder for rapidly creating polished web pages and application interfaces.

  • **Vercel** — Deploy web apps from GitHub with automatic preview links for every update.

  • **Supabase** — Backend toolkit with database, authentication, storage, and APIs for app builders.

  • **Stripe** — Payments infrastructure for subscriptions and checkout; build in test mode before charging
  anyone.

  • **Sentry** — Error monitoring that tells you when users hit bugs after launch.

author: adramelekh.
content:
## 🤖 AI & Agents
  • **Codex** — AI coding agent that can plan, write, test, and improve projects directly in a codebase.

  • **Claude Code** — Terminal-based AI coding agent for building, debugging, and understanding full
  projects.

  • **Cursor** — AI-first code editor that is approachable for builders who want an IDE experience.

  • **Grok AI / Grok Build** — xAI’s assistant and coding agent for brainstorming, coding, and agentic
  development work.

  • **Grok Bot** — Persistent AI teammates that can work across connected tools and systems; useful for
  delegating ongoing research, product, or ops tasks to an agent team.

  • **Caveman** — Optional agent skill that makes coding-agent responses shorter and more token-efficient;
  best for experienced builders.

  • **Hugging Face Skills** — Installable AI-agent instructions for model training, datasets, evaluations,
  Gradio apps, and Hugging Face workflows.
